card.incident_road_a.text: The road home. Twenty minutes. On the radio, someone is laughing about football. Your phone lights the passenger seat: the Minister. *"Tonight was noted. — V."*
card.incident_collision.text: Headlights where headlights should not be — and then not headlights, a shape, and the shape is a person, and there is a fraction of a second that belongs entirely to you.
card.incident_immediate_choice.text: The engine ticks. The road is quiet the way a room is quiet after glass breaks. Behind you, on the asphalt, someone is not getting up.
card.incident_stay.text: Your hands are steadier than they have any right to be. Two names sit at the top of your recent calls: the emergency line, and the person who fixes things.
card.incident_leave.text: Four kilometers later, the phone. The Aide, in the voice kept for real things: "Where are you right now? Something's coming over the police channel — the villa road."
card.incident_call_b.text: You are home, shoes still on, when the phone rings. The Aide, in the voice kept for real things: "There's been an accident on the villa road. It's ours."
card.incident_identity_b.text: "The Mentor's car," the Aide says. "The riverside stretch. A young woman who was walking home." A breath. "He didn't stay. He was at your table two hours ago."
card.incident_first_request_b.text: "We need time before this becomes public," the Minister says. It is one in the morning and his voice has been ironed flat. "A few hours. Nothing irreversible."
card.incident_emergency_b.text: The hospital calls your office directly, because at this hour, at this level, someone must authorize the transfer team. Down the hall from all the politics, a surgical unit is waiting on paperwork.
card.incident_emergency_b.left: Give them everything they ask for. Tonight.
card.incident_emergency_b.right: Route it through the local officials.
card.incident_explicit_request_b.text: "He has served this country for thirty years," the Minister says. The sentence has been rehearsed; you can hear where the pauses were placed. "You know what a trial would take from all of us. I am asking what can be arranged."
card.aftermath_first_article.text: Page three, morning edition: *"Young woman critically injured in late-night collision on the villa road. The driver has not been publicly identified."* Your office phone starts ringing before you finish the paragraph.
card.aftermath_first_article_captured.te: The Editor calls before the print run. "I've seen tomorrow's page three. A young woman, the villa road, an unnamed driver." A pause that costs nothing yet. "Say the word."
The investigator arrives without calling ahead. You did not appoint her; you cannot name who did — that was the point. "Your office does not have authority over this inquiry," she says, evenly. "I'm informing you as a courtesy. And collecting your statement while I'm here."
card.aftermath_investigator_controlled.t: The investigator waits to be invited in. You appointed his director's director. "We'll need guidance on scope," he says, to the carpet. "Whenever convenient."
card.aftermath_records.text: "They've asked for the calendar, the call logs, the gathering's guest list," the Aide says. The drawer with the other list — the one from before — is not mentioned, and is very loud about it.
card.aftermath_compensation.text: The family's lawyer is younger than you expected and does not sit down. "They are not asking about the driver today. There are surgeries, and lost work, and a lawyer — which is me, and I am not expensive." A beat. "They did ask me to ask: who called the ambulance."
card.aftermath_responsibility_a.text: Your statement is due at nine. The Aide has drafted three versions and placed only one on top. It is the shortest. It is also the only one written in the first person.
card.aftermath_responsibility_b.text: "The prosecutor's file is ready," the Aide says. "It needs one thing to move: your office declining to intervene." A pause. "And it needs one thing to stop: the opposite."
card.aftermath_network_exposed.text: The calls stop by noon. The Mentor's number, the Businessman's, the Editor's — a column of names that no longer ring. The Minister's statement mentions "disappointment in a colleague we trusted." You are the colleague.
card.aftermath_network_covered.text: Flowers arrive with no card. The Businessman's assistant calls about "continuity." The Editor's Sunday editorial praises "steady hands in difficult hours." Everyone is warmer than they have ever been — the way rooms are warm before doors close.
card.aftermath_reformist_steady.text: The Reformist calls, and for once has nothing to argue. "Then let the process continue," she says. "That's all. That was always all."
card.aftermath_reformist_plea.text: "You still have time to stop this," the Reformist says from the doorway, not coming in. "Not to fix it. To stop adding to it. Those are different things, and you know which one is still yours."
card.aftermath_aide_substitute.text: The Aide stays after hours again, the old list somewhere in a drawer. "I'm not the person who was supposed to say this to you. That person isn't here anymore." A breath. "So: you can still stop adding to it."
card.aftermath_media_clean.text: The press office needs a decision by six. On one screen, everything you know, in order. On the other, three paragraphs that are true and insufficient.
card.aftermath_media_corrupt.text: Two papers are preparing follow-ups; one has the guest list. The press office needs a decision by six, and the word "publish" has quietly left the building.
card.aftermath_media_captured.text: "It's four outlets and two platforms," the Editor says, the way a man reads a shopping list. "By Friday, the words won't search. You built this switch over two years." He looks up. "I'm only asking whether you want it pressed."
card.aftermath_media_captured.right: Remove the reports. Restrict the discussion.
card.aftermath_institution_a.text: The letter needs one signature or none. Outside, the building goes on being a building. Whatever you sign, tomorrow it will still know how to hold meetings.
card.aftermath_institution_b.text: The file will reach the prosecutor by Monday unless something reaches it first. Your office still has hands long enough. The only question left is whether they move.
card.aftermath_intervention_failed.text: The order comes back the next morning with a single line attached: *"Your office does not have authority over this inquiry."* You created that sentence. It has been waiting two years to be about you.
card.aftermath_intervention_succeeded.te: By evening the inquiry has a new scope and a new schedule. Nothing was refused. Nothing needed to be.
ending.ending_break_the_chain.title: Break the Chain
ending.ending_break_the_chain.text: The trial opened in spring. You were not in the courtroom; former deputies rarely are. The authority you voted to create outlived your career by exactly as long as it was designed to: indefinitely. The young woman's family attended every session. They were never made to ask twice.
ending.ending_accountability.title: Accountability
ending.ending_accountability.text: You confessed on a Tuesday. The office was gone by Friday; the case took a year. She lived — the surgeons said the first twenty minutes decided it, and you had spent them on the phone with an ambulance instead of a lawyer. No one called you brave. The sentence was served in full: the court's, and the one you read yourself every morning.
ending.ending_too_late.title: Too Late
ending.ending_too_late.text: You resigned three days later. The investigation continued; the confession was complete and the cooperation was real. None of it reached back to the minutes on the roadside. She had them alone. Chronology does not negotiate.
ending.ending_protected.title: Protected
ending.ending_protected.text: Eighteen months later, you were reappointed. The file is technically open. Her name appears in one archived article, spelled two different ways. Your approval recovered by autumn. ♥ 4.
ending.ending_untouchable.title: Untouchable
ending.ending_untouchable.text: "The matter has been reviewed according to procedure." — Searches for the villa road now return sixteen results, all real estate.
ending.ending_collapse.title: Collapse
ending.ending_collapse.text: The resignations arrived in alphabetical order — which is how you knew they were coordinated. Orders went out and came back unopened. On the last morning the driver did not come; there was no one left to send him. POWER: 0.
ending.ending_scapegoat.title: Scapegoat
ending.ending_scapegoat.text: The network's statement named you by noon. By evening, documents you had never seen carried your routing stamp. The Minister expressed disappointment; the Businessman's lawyers expressed nothing. The Editor ran it on the front page — it was, everyone agreed, the best story of his career.
ending.ending_fallback.title: The Term Ended
ending.ending_fallback.text: The term ended. Another began, for someone else. The road keeps its tree.
article.article_first_report.headline: Young woman critically injured in late-night collision on the villa road.
article.article_first_report.body.1: The driver has not been publicly identified.

memorial.dedication.anonymous: For the ones who were walking home.
credits.quote: Power tends to corrupt, and absolute power corrupts absolutely. — Lord Acton
